style.name: Bearridge Minimal Flat
style.description: Minimalist 2D flat illustration style with simplified geometric forms and a restrained, muted color palette. Characters, objects and environments are constructed from large clean color shapes with very limited internal detail. No visible decorative outlines, no realistic textures, no gradients and no photorealistic rendering. Human anatomy and facial features are intentionally simplified while preserving clear silhouettes and recognizable proportions. Clothing is represented with broad flat shapes and only a few simplified folds. Environments use simplified geometry and reduced architectural detail. The overall image should feel graphic, clean, restrained and cinematic.
style.linework: Shape-driven illustration with little to no visible contour linework. Forms should be defined primarily by adjacent flat color areas and silhouettes rather than outlines. Avoid thin decorative lines, sketch lines, comic-style ink outlines and excessive internal line detail.
style.anatomy: Simplified but believable human anatomy with natural adult proportions. Bodies should remain clearly readable through strong silhouettes and large geometric shapes. Reduce anatomical detail while preserving correct limb placement, posture and overall proportions. Avoid exaggerated cartoon anatomy and photorealistic anatomical detail.
style.shading: Minimal flat shading. Use a small number of large, hard-edged shadow shapes rather than smooth tonal transitions. Shadows may simplify or merge details into broad dark areas. No gradients, soft airbrushed shading, ambient occlusion, complex reflections or realistic material rendering.
style.negativeRules:
No photorealism. No 3D-rendered appearance. No realistic textures. No gradients. No glossy materials. No painterly brushwork. No sketch lines. No detailed comic-book outlines. No visible eyes, eyeballs, pupils, irises, eye whites, eyelashes, or realistic eye details. No detailed facial rendering. No detailed fabric texture. No complex reflections. No bloom. No volumetric lighting. No photographic depth of field. No excessive small details. Do not introduce visual detail absent from the established minimalist flat style.
Never generate internal facial features on human characters.

No eyes, pupils, irises, eye whites, eyelashes, eyebrows, noses, nostrils, mouths or lips.

No subtle facial-feature lines or shading that imply missing facial features.

Do not reconstruct eyes behind canonical glasses.
Do not reconstruct a mouth beneath canonical facial hair.

Do not add facial features for emotional expression.
Express emotion through pose, head orientation, body language and other style-appropriate non-facial cues.
